clues: This city sits in the south east of England, by the north bank of the Thames. London lies not far to the west, a short trip by road or rail.
This is one of the driest spots in the whole United Kingdom. Summers here stay a bit more cool than in London, not far away.
In the 1790s, the first buildings went up round what became its High Street. That rise marks the start of the town as a place of its own.
This city is home to the longest pleasure pier in the world. It is a long deck made for strolls and fun days out.
In 2022, this place won city rank in memory of Sir David Amess. The law maker was killed in 2021 while he met with local folks.
